standardApplied.measuredHere: Every obligation below was measured in this lane from the committed artifacts at the base sha named above. standardApplied.SOURCE_IDENTITY: Met only by recomputing every bound source hash from the source bytes. The Master Library is not mounted in this container, so families that bind corpus bytes are NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE; families that bind only committed repository records were rehashed here and can pass.
standardApplied.FILING_DESTINATION: Met when the participant-facing instructions, or a participant-facing page of the packet, name the court, clerk or agency the route names. A prefilled caption identifying a court type is evidence but is not on its own the instructions naming a destination.
standardApplied.FEE_AND_WAIVER: Met when the packet states the filing fee AND a waiver route. A fee printed on a form the packet fills and selects counts as stated; a statute stating that no fee is payable counts as stated, and where no fee is payable there is no waiver to name. An instruction to ask someone what the fee is does not count.
standardApplied.SERVICE: Met when the packet states who must be served and by what method. A rule that the participant serves nobody, stated affirmatively with the mechanism that replaces it, counts. An instruction to ask the clerk who must be served does not.
standardApplied.SELF_HELP_STOP: Met when the packet states where the platform stops and the participant or a lawyer takes over - which facts it will not supply, which fields it will not sign, and that the artifact carries no approval.
standardApplied.contractNote: Lane contract L9 requires that a PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT verdict score all fifteen canonical obligations by name. An earlier pass by this verifier scored a seven-item subset and is superseded by this one; git history preserves it. data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/VERMONT_REPAIR.json records that FILING_DESTINATION was once scored FAIL by two verifiers and PASS by a third on identical bytes, so the standard applied here is stated above rather than left implicit.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Step 4 names the destination affirmatively: "Send it to the Criminal Division of the Superior Court that entered the deferred sentence, under the existing docket - it is not a new case, and nothing is paid." The three confirmation steps that precede it each name the office to ask (the clerk of that same Criminal Division, and the Restitution Unit of the Vermont Center for Crime Victim Services).

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The fee is stated, and it is zero, on the statute rather than on an absence of information: 13 V.S.A. Sec. 7041(e) requires the record expunged on discharge "with no fee of any kind", which the instructions state in the opening paragraph and repeat at step 4 ("nothing is paid"). Where the statute imposes no fee there is no waiver to name, and the packet does not invent one. This is the opposite of the "ask the clerk what it costs" shape that fails this obligation elsewhere in these two lanes.

SERVICE.finding: Stated affirmatively and correctly inverted: the participant serves nobody. Step 5 records that "After the order issues, the court sends copies to each agency, department or official named in it - not you." SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The packet states where the platform stops. participant-instructions.md carries a "What this packet is not" section saying in terms that it is not legal advice, is not filed for the participant, and decides nothing, and names the categories the platform will never complete - signatures, signature dates, service certifications, court-only, agency-only, prosecutor-only and victim fields.
